android-fork-release-apk.yml:build-unsig.exit: Android fork release moves to a Buzz release request (after #185 freezes the contract) or Victor parks the fork APK path

android-fork-release-apk.yml:sign.exit: Victor decides keystore creation or unsigned-only; the android-release environment secrets do not exist yet
android-fork-release-apk.yml:sign.note: The four BUZZ_ANDROID_RELEASE_* secrets are referenced but not provisioned (#146).

android-fork-release-tag.yml:publish.exit: tag publication moves to a signed Buzz release status event; needs contents:write on GitHub today

auto-tag-on-release-pr-merge.yml:auto-ta.exit: release tagging moves to the Buzz landing procedure; the step already skips only21mil/buzz (line 64), so it is a no-op in the fork
auto-tag-on-release-pr-merge.yml:auto-ta.note: Runs on every merged main PR but exits early for only21mil/buzz; the fork tags releases through scripts/prepare-desktop-release.sh.

benchmark-harbor.yml:test.exit: job folds into ci.yml (native CI executes only .github/workflows/ci.yml) or the executor accepts other workflow paths

ci.yml:changes.exit: native runs every required ci.yml job for main PRs without path filtering; the ruleset drops this context in the reviewed reversible cutover step
ci.yml:changes.note: GitHub-only path filter (dorny/paths-filter). Native requests select job_ids explicitly, so nothing replaces it.

ci.yml:desktop.note: Aggregate check over desktop-core and the four smoke shards; the ruleset requires this name, not the shards.

ci.yml:desktop-build-macos.exit: an apple-mbp executor class produces this check natively, or Victor removes the context from the ruleset
ci.yml:desktop-build-macos.note: Only required check on a macOS runner; the Linux native executor cannot produce it.

ci.yml:desktop-e2e-integration-shard.note: Needs docker compose (postgres, redis, minio) inside the executor; execd policy proxy admission is the gap to prove.

ci.yml:desktop-smoke-e2e.note: Four shards; scripts/protected-ci-reuse.py already keys reuse by desktop-smoke-{n}.

ci.yml:mobile-ios.exit: Apple release request contract and apple-mbp executor class accepted; until then admission needs a reviewed BUZZ_IOS_CI_RUNNER_LABELS selector
ci.yml:mobile-ios.note: Self-hosted MBP labels come from vars; not a required check.

ci.yml:security.note: Reuse binds the RustSec advisory revision (docs/delivery-lifecycle.md); native execution must retain that binding.

desktop-release-candidate.yml:validate.exit: landed desktop identity verification issues a Buzz-signed receipt instead of a GitHub check, or the check folds into ci.yml
desktop-release-candidate.yml:validate.note: Required check produced outside ci.yml; native CI executes only ci.yml today.

docker-pr.yml:build.exit: executor admits linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 image builds through the execd policy proxy, or validation folds into ci.yml

docker.yml:build.exit: relay image publishes from Buzz; GHCR push with OIDC attestations has no native equivalent
docker.yml:build.note: Runs in the fork only when vars.GHCR_IMAGE is set.

helm-chart.yml:install-on-kind.exit: chart validation folds into ci.yml or a native workflow path; dispatch-only today

helm-chart.yml:publish.exit: chart publishes from Buzz; GHCR push has no native equivalent

linux-canary.yml:build.exit: Linux canary builds run as a kind 46100 request against the native executor

mesh-lifecycle.yml:lifecycle-smoke.exit: smoke folds into ci.yml (path-filtered PR job outside the native workflow path)

mobile-release-candidate.yml:publish.note: No if: gate, but the step refuses any repository other than block/buzz (line 50).

push-gateway-helm-chart.yml:publish.exit: chart publishes from Buzz; GHCR push has no native equivalent

relay_e2e_canary.yml:relay_e2e_canary.exit: canary dispatch becomes a kind 46100 request and the ruleset context follows; today the reviewed candidate attempt satisfies it (docs/delivery-lifecycle.md)
relay_e2e_canary.yml:relay_e2e_canary.note: Required check that only workflow_dispatch produces; nothing runs it automatically on a PR.

release.yml:assemble-manifest.note: Transitively: requires every release job to succeed and those are gated on block/buzz.

release.yml:release-windows.note: No if: gate of its own; skipped because needs: setup is gated on block/buzz.

sprig-image.yml:merge.exit: image publishes from Buzz; GHCR push with attestations has no native equivalent

sprig-image.yml:validate.exit: PR validation folds into ci.yml or the executor admits arm64 image builds

sprig.yml:build.exit: sprig binaries build under a kind 46100 request; release upload stays a GitHub contents:write step until Buzz hosts releases
